facts.text: The Pathways Program, a defining element of The Furman Advantage, is a two-year advising program starting in the first year to guide each student's four-year pathway.

sources.title: Why Furman: The Furman Advantage | Furman University
sources.quote: The Pathways Program®, a defining element of The Furman Advantage, is a two-year advising program that students start in their first year to ease their transition to college and explore their individualized pathway.
